Dr Ning Liu

Research Scientist at Environment Unit at CSIRO, with expertise and experience in the geographic information system (GIS) & remote sensing, modelling, climate change, and carbon mitigation.

Research Interests

  • GIS and remote sensing
  • Environmental modelling
  • Climate change and carbon mitigation
  • Global biogeochemical cycles
  • Machine learning and big data computing

Research Experience

  • Current Research Scientist, Environment Unit, Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO), Australia
  • 2021-- Post Doctoral Research Fellow, Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, TN, USA
  • 2019--2020 Post-doctoral Research Fellow, University of Minnesota, United States
  • 2019-- Honorary Research Fellow, Murdoch University, Western Australia, Australia
  • 2017--2018 Post-doctoral Research Fellow, Murdoch University, Western Australia, Australia
  • 2014--2017 PhD, Environmental Science, Murdoch University, Western Australia, Australia
  • 2010--2013 MSc, Ecology, Chinese Academy of Forestry, Beijing, China
  • 2006--2010 BSc, Forestry, Shandong Agriculture University, Tai'an, China
